profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Virta Health

positions.title: Engineering Project Lead
positions.description:
Managed two direct reports and led the Quia Web and Quia Books Development teams. 

Oversaw development for projects from inception to completion including scope, specifications, resource management, testing, implementation, and ongoing support.

Collaborated with the book development and tech support teams to prioritize enhancements, new capabilities projects, and bug fixes; identified workarounds available and determined urgency for defect changes including customer impact, business operations, and productivity.

Customized the registration, sign-up, and reporting for the National Spanish Exam taken by 150K+ students annually. Enhanced reporting capabilities to facilitate running and printing reports and analyzing test results.

Managed the newly formed Business Platform team focused on internal sales platform and user access systems.
